Container.Name: Parakeet-Redux
Container.Overview: Local multilingual speech recognition using Moondream Parakeet Redux on CPU (parakeet.cpp, packed GGUF). Includes OpenAI-style HTTP transcription and Wyoming for Home Assistant. Accepts streaming audio chunks; returns final text after audio-stop, NOT incremental text. Linux amd64 AVX2 CPU required; no GPU. First start downloads and verifies a 213 MB CC-BY-4.0 model. Independent integration, not an official Moondream app. Not submitted to Community Applications. New ports do not replace existing Whisper. Keep on a trusted LAN; Wyoming is unauthenticated.

Config.Name: HTTP port
Config.Description: HTTP transcription API. Do not use your existing Whisper port.

Config.Name: Wyoming port
Config.Description: Home Assistant Wyoming protocol. No TLS/auth; trusted LAN only.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent model cache. Directory must be writable by Unraid nobody:users (99:100).

Config.Name: CPU threads
Config.Description: Native inference threads. Default two; adjust CPU quota in Extra Parameters if increasing.

Config.Name: Maximum audio seconds
Config.Description: Maximum utterance/file length (1–600 seconds). Long recordings are segmented internally.

Config.Name: Inference timeout
Config.Description: Worker timeout in seconds (1–600); a stuck worker is restarted.

Config.Name: HTTP API key
Config.Description: Optional HTTP bearer token for /v1 routes only. Does NOT secure Wyoming. Never expose either port to the internet.
